title: NeoOrigins Power
description: A power grants one mechanical effect to a player via the origins system. File path: data/<namespace>/origins/powers/<power>.json. The `type` field discriminates which fields are valid.

type.description: Fully-qualified power type ID. See docs/API.md for the full catalogue.

name.description: Display name. Plain string = translation key.

hidden.description: When true, this power is excluded from the origin info panel. Useful for purely-internal flag/glue powers (e.g. neoorigins:toggle, action_on_hit setters under a multiple).

event.description: Case-insensitive event key that triggers this hook (e.g. food_eaten, block_break, mod_exhaustion). See docs/EVENTS.md.

condition.description: Optional DSL condition gating the action/modifier; both only run while it passes (default always).

entity_action.description: EntityAction run on the player as a side-effect when the configured event fires.

modifier.description: FloatModifier (or array) chained onto the event's value (e.g. exhaustion, regen).

block_condition.description: Block-position filter for block events (block_break, block_place, block_use). Ignored on other events.

effect.description: EFFECT_APPLIED filter: only fire for this exact mob-effect id (e.g. 'spore:mycelium_ef'). Ignored on other events.

effect_tag.description: EFFECT_APPLIED filter: only fire for effects in this tag (e.g. '#minecraft:harmful'). Combine with 'effect' (OR-matched). Ignored on other events.

immunity_ticks.description: EFFECT_APPLIED only: after a successful cleanse (action cancels the event), grant this many ticks of full immunity to the same effect id before re-rolling. 20 = 1s; default 0 (no grace).

action.description: Effect on dealing damage: restore_health, restore_hunger, grant_effect, or target_effect.

amount.description: Half-hearts healed (restore_health) or food points fed (restore_hunger); default 2.0.

effect.description: Mob effect id applied to self (grant_effect) or the victim (target_effect).

duration.description: Effect duration in ticks for grant/target_effect (20 = 1s); default 100.

amplifier.description: Potion amplifier for grant_effect/target_effect (0 = level I); default 0.

min_damage.description: Minimum incoming damage required before the action triggers; default 0.0.

chance.description: Probability 0.0-1.0 the action triggers per qualifying hit; default 1.0.

target_group.description: Optional entity-group filter (undead, arthropod, ...) restricting which victims trigger it.

target_type.description: Optional specific entity-type id filter for the victim.

damage_type.description: Optional damage-type id filter; the action only fires for matching sources.

cooldown_ticks.description: Cooldown between uses in ticks (20 = 1s); default 60.

hunger_cost.description: Food/exhaustion points consumed per successful activation; default 0.

resource_cost.description: Optional resource power id whose value is spent on activation; empty = no resource cost.

resource_cost_amount.description: Amount of the resource_cost resource consumed per activation; default 0.

entity_action.description: EntityAction tree executed on the player when the keybind fires (defaults to noop).

condition.description: Optional DSL condition gating the ability; it only fires while this passes (default always).

speed.description: Velocity of the launched wind charge along the look direction; default 1.2.

cooldown_ticks.description: Cooldown between casts in ticks (20 = 1s); default 80.

power.description: Magnitude of the dash velocity vector; default 1.5.

cooldown_ticks.description: Cooldown between dashes in ticks (20 = 1s); default 40.

allow_vertical.description: If true the dash follows look pitch; if false it stays horizontal; default false.

set_velocity.description: If true replace the player's velocity; if false add to it; default false.

speed.description: Velocity applied to each of the spread small fireballs; default 1.5.

cooldown_ticks.description: Cooldown between casts in ticks (20 = 1s); default 100.

max_depth.description: Maximum wall thickness in blocks the phase can pass through; default 16.

cooldown_ticks.description: Cooldown between phases in ticks (20 = 1s); default 40.

hunger_cost.description: Food/exhaustion points consumed on a successful phase; default 0.

block_id.description: Block id placed at the targeted face; default minecraft:glowstone.

max_distance.description: Maximum ray-pick reach in blocks for the placement surface; default 5.0.

cooldown_ticks.description: Cooldown between placements in ticks (20 = 1s); default 100.

hunger_cost.description: Food/exhaustion points consumed on a successful placement; default 0.

cooldown_ticks.description: Cooldown in ticks (20 = 1s) between recalls to bed/spawn; default 600.

range.description: Max distance in blocks to find the looked-at entity to swap with; default 20.0.

cooldown_ticks.description: Cooldown between swaps in ticks (20 = 1s); default 80.

range.description: Maximum teleport distance in blocks; default 32.0.

cooldown_ticks.description: Cooldown between teleports in ticks (20 = 1s); default 60.

mode.description: "target" teleports to the looked-at spot, "random" to a nearby safe spot; default target.

hunger_cost.description: Food/exhaustion points consumed on a successful teleport; default 0.

attribute.description: Attribute id to modify, e.g. minecraft:generic.movement_speed or minecraft:block_interaction_range / entity_interaction_range for reach; required.

amount.description: Numeric value applied to the attribute under the chosen operation; required.

operation.description: How amount applies: add_value, add_multiplied_base, or add_multiplied_total.

condition.description: Optional gate: a named-condition string (in_water/on_land/in_lava) or a DSL condition object; active only while it passes.

equipment_condition.description: Optional gate matching a worn item by id/tag in a slot; active only while worn.

item.description: Exact item id the worn item must match (e.g. minecraft:elytra).

tag.description: Item tag the worn item must be in (e.g. minecraft:swords).

location_condition.description: Optional gate on dimension/biome/structure; active only while there.

dimension.description: Dimension the player must be in, e.g. minecraft:the_nether (combines with AND).

biome.description: Exact biome id to match, e.g. minecraft:desert (biome fields OR-combine).

biome_tag.description: Biome tag the current biome must be in, e.g. minecraft:is_forest (OR-combines with biome/biomes).

biomes.description: List of biome ids; matching any one satisfies the biome requirement (OR-combines with biome/biome_tag).

structure.description: Exact structure id the position must be inside, e.g. minecraft:village_plains (combines with AND).

structure_tag.description: Structure tag the position must be inside, e.g. minecraft:village (combines with AND).

allow_water_surface.description: When resolving a spawn, allow standing on the water surface (default false).

allow_ocean_floor.description: When resolving a spawn, allow the ocean floor under water (default false).

min_y.description: Minimum Y for the spawn/location search band (optional).

max_y.description: Maximum Y for the spawn/location search band (optional).

can_see_sky.description: Require open sky (true) or allow caves/underground (false). Default: true on overworld-like dimensions, false in ceiling dimensions like the Nether.

tool.description: Vanilla tool item id the empty hand emulates for tier/break speed; default stone_pickaxe.

multiplier.description: Mining-speed multiplier; stacks multiplicatively with other instances; default 2.0.

fluid.description: Fluid that suffocates the player, "water" or "lava"; default water.

drain_interval_ticks.description: Ticks between each 1-point air drain while submerged; higher = slower drain (20 = 1s). Aliases: drain_rate, air_loss_per_second.

fluid.description: Fluid the player must stay in to breathe; drying on land drains air.

drain_rate.description: Ticks between each air drain while out of the fluid (20 = 1s).

interval.description: Ticks between each fire application; <=0 disables (default 20).

burn_duration.description: Ticks of fire set on the player each application (20 = 1s; default 100).

range.description: Max block distance of the look-targeted entity your tamed mobs attack (default 32).

cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks before this ability can be triggered again (default 40).

condition.description: Optional EntityCondition gating the action: entity_action runs each interval only while it passes; else_action runs while it does not (default always-true).

entity_action.description: EntityAction run on the player each interval while the condition passes (defaults to noop).

else_action.description: EntityAction run on the player each interval while the condition does NOT pass (defaults to noop).

condition.description: Built-in player-state gate the inner power is active under: climbing, in_water, on_ground, or always (default always). Unknown values fall back to always.

inner_power.description: Required resource id of another power that is only active while this condition holds (e.g. 'neoorigins:flight').

output_item.description: Item id whose crafting triggers the bonus (default oak_planks).

bonus_count.description: Extra copies of the output added per craft (default 4; skipped if <=0).

radius.description: Cubic block radius around the player scanned for crops (default 4).

growths_per_interval.description: Number of random nearby crops bone-mealed each interval (default 1).

extra_drops.description: Extra copies of the block's own loot when breaking crops/logs (default 1).

chance.description: Probability 0.0-1.0 to fully cancel an incoming damage event (default 0.15).

items.description: List of item ids that become edible (matches items OR tags).

tags.description: List of item-tag ids that become edible (matches items OR tags).

always_edible.description: If true the item can be eaten even at full hunger (default true).

consume_sound.description: Optional sound-event id played on consumption; omit to use the default eat sound.

effects.description: Mob effect IDs (e.g. minecraft:poison) whose application to the player is cancelled. Empty list = no immunity.

strength.description: Multiplier on the forward impulse applied while elytra gliding (default 1.5).

cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks before the boost can be triggered again (default 40).

exposure.description: Brightness 0-1 in darkness; client currently uses ~0.7 (default 0.7).

group.description: Mob classification: undead, arthropod, water, or undefined (changes effect/enchant interactions).

name.description: Named UUID set this power declares the player a member of; namespace it (e.g. 'mypack:kill_streak') to avoid collisions. Read/mutated by the in_set / add_to_set / remove_from_set verbs.

sources.description: Exhaustion sources to suppress, e.g. sprint, mining (default [sprint]).

size.description: Slot count, rounded to a multiple of 9 (min 9, max 54; default 9).

drop_on_death.description: If true the extra inventory drops on death instead of persisting (default false).

effect.description: Mob effect that must be active on the player for the Fortune bonus.

level.description: Virtual Fortune level rolled via the vanilla ore-drops formula.

target.description: Block tag the bonus applies to (default #c:ores; ancient debris excluded).

damage.description: Damage dealt to each entity caught in the slam (default 6.0).

knockback_strength.description: Outward knockback pushing hit entities away (default 1.5).

radius.description: Blocks around the player whose entities are hit (default 6.0).

cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks before the slam can be reused (default 120 = 6s).

bar.description: Which HUD bar to hide: hunger/food or air/oxygen/breath (default hunger).

heal_amount.description: Health restored to each eligible tamed mob per interval (default 1.0).

combat_cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks a tamed mob must avoid damage before it can heal (default 100).

damage_types.description: Damage-type ids (e.g. minecraft:fall) whose damage is cancelled.

damage_tags.description: Damage-type tag ids (e.g. minecraft:is_fire) whose damage is cancelled.

msg_ids.description: Vanilla damage msgId strings (e.g. inFire, fall) whose damage is cancelled.

radius.description: Blocks around the player within which dropped items are pulled in (default 4.0).

js_id.description: ID of the JS handler. Register from JS via NeoOrigins.registerActivePower(id, {onUse, onGranted, onRevoked}).

cooldown_ticks.description: Cooldown between uses in ticks (20 = 1s), consumed only when the JS onUse returns true; default 20.

hunger_cost.description: Food/exhaustion points consumed on a successful activation (JS onUse returns true); default 0.

js_id.description: ID of the JS handler. Register from JS via NeoOrigins.registerPower(id, {onGranted, onRevoked, onTick}).

slots.description: Slot categories kept: hotbar, main, armor, offhand, or * for all (default *).

items.description: Item ids to keep on death; empty (with empty tags) keeps everything.

tags.description: Item tag ids whose matching items are kept on death.

strength.description: Lava fog distance multiplier; higher sees farther in lava (default 3.0).

item_type.description: Item being used that gets reduced slowdown: any, bow, shield, or an id substring.

speed_multiplier.description: Movement-speed bonus while using the item, as a fraction of base (default 0.5).

max_light_level.description: Highest light level at which the effect still applies (default 4).

effect.description: Mob effect id applied at/below the light threshold (required).

ambient.description: Whether the applied effect is ambient (fainter particles; default true).

show_particles.description: Whether the effect's ambient particles are shown (default false).

show_icon.description: Whether the effect's HUD icon is shown (default false).

grant_id.description: Unique id tracked so the bundle is granted only once per player. Dedups the whole pool, not individual rolled stacks. Shares the starting_equipment grant attachment so a /origin reset clears both.

loot_table.description: ResourceLocation of the vanilla loot table to roll on activation (e.g. 'neoorigins:rewards/wood_starter'). Reuses the full vanilla loot infrastructure (weighted entries, conditions, functions, modifiers).

rolls.description: Number of times the table is rolled per activation; default 1. Combined with bonus_rolls; if both are zero the harness lints the power as a no-op.

bonus_rolls.description: Extra rolls added to `rolls` per activation; default 0. Mirrors vanilla loot-pool naming.

active.description: Optional display-only translation key advertising which keybind slot the power expects (e.g. 'key.use_skill_1'). Actual dispatch is via the skill-slot system.

cooldown.description: Cooldown in ticks between activations (20 = 1s); default 0.

threshold.description: Health fraction below which the effects activate (0.5 = 50%; default 0.5).

effects.description: List of {effect, amplifier} entries applied while below the threshold.

aggression.description: neutral = vanilla AI unchanged (only retaliate applies); hostile = always target the target type on sight; conditional = target a player only while every hostile_when condition holds. Default neutral.

hostile_when.description: List of conditions (AND-ed) tested against the PROSPECTIVE PLAYER TARGET (piglin-style, e.g. 'player not wearing gold'), not the mob. Only used when aggression = conditional; empty list behaves like hostile.

retaliate.description: Also fight back against whatever damaged the mob (vanilla hurt-by-target). Default true.

anger_linger_ticks.description: Keep the target this many ticks after the trigger stops holding, so the mob calms down gradually instead of instantly (default 200 = 10s).

aggro_range.description: Max distance to acquire a target (default 16.0).

target_type.description: Entity type id to be hostile toward; omitted = players. Conditions only apply to player targets.

call_for_help.description: When retaliating, alert nearby same-type mobs (vanilla pack aggro). Default false.

entity_types.description: Entity ids or #tags of mobs that never aggro or target this player. Empty/omitted = matches every mob.

passive.description: When true, the ignore is unconditional — even hitting the mob does not provoke retaliation. Default false (the mob may target back briefly after being hit).

red.description: Red channel of the player model tint, 0.0 to 1.0 (default 1.0).

green.description: Green channel of the player model tint, 0.0 to 1.0 (default 1.0).

blue.description: Blue channel of the player model tint, 0.0 to 1.0 (default 1.0).

alpha.description: Player model tint opacity, 0.0 transparent to 1.0 opaque (default 1.0).

condition.description: Only applies the tint while this DSL condition passes (optional).

direction.description: "in" scales damage taken, "out" scales damage dealt (default in).

damage_type.description: Either a vanilla msg ID (e.g. 'onFire') or a tag prefixed with #.

multiplier.description: Factor applied to the damage; 0.5 halves, 2.0 doubles (default 1.0).

target_group.description: Optional entity-group filter limiting which targets/attackers apply.

condition.description: Only applies the multiplier while this DSL condition passes (optional).

nutrition.description: Hunger points matching food gives, saturation scaled with it (default 1).

food_item.description: Optional item id; only this food's nutrition is overridden.

food_tag.description: Optional item tag; only matching foods are overridden.

operation.description: How value combines with the vanilla lava factor: addition, multiply_base, multiply_total.

value.description: Amount applied to lava movement speed (addition ~0.4 ≈ walking pace in lava).

location.description: Nested LocationCondition object resolving the respawn target (its own dimension/biome/biome_tag/biomes/structure/structure_tag/etc. fields). Required — the power has no respawn target without it.

dimension.description: Dimension the player must be in, e.g. minecraft:the_nether (combines with AND).

biome.description: Exact biome id to match, e.g. minecraft:desert (biome fields OR-combine).

biome_tag.description: Biome tag the current biome must be in, e.g. minecraft:is_forest (OR-combines with biome/biomes).

biomes.description: List of biome ids; matching any one satisfies the biome requirement (OR-combines with biome/biome_tag).

structure.description: Exact structure id the position must be inside, e.g. minecraft:village_plains (combines with AND).

structure_tag.description: Structure tag the position must be inside, e.g. minecraft:village (combines with AND).

allow_water_surface.description: When resolving a spawn, allow standing on the water surface (default false).

allow_ocean_floor.description: When resolving a spawn, allow the ocean floor under water (default false).

min_y.description: Minimum Y for the spawn/location search band (optional).

max_y.description: Maximum Y for the spawn/location search band (optional).

can_see_sky.description: Require open sky (true) or allow caves/underground (false). Default: true on overworld-like dimensions, false in ceiling dimensions like the Nether.

override_bed.description: When true also overrides the player's bed/respawn-anchor spawn point, not just the post-death respawn position (default false).

range.description: Max distance in blocks to raycast for the entity to mount (default 5).

cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks before the mount ability can be reused (100 = 5s).

hunger_cost.description: Hunger consumed each time an entity is mounted.

allow_players.description: Whether this power can mount other players (default true).

allow_mobs.description: Whether this power can mount mobs (default true).

block_bosses.description: Prevent mounting boss mobs like the Ender Dragon or Wither (default true).

mount_position.description: Where the rider sits: 'centered' (on top) or 'shoulder' (offset to one side).

radius.description: Block radius around the player where natural spawning is suppressed (default 24). Vanilla already blocks MONSTER-category natural spawns within 24 blocks of any player, so use a value above 24 to extend the safe zone meaningfully.

categories.description: Mob groups blocked: monster, creature, ambient, water_creature, or all (default monster).

block_tag.description: Block tag to limit slowdown immunity to; omit for immunity to all slowdown.

texture.description: Resource location of the full-screen texture rendered over the view.

effects.description: List of effect entries, each {effect|id, amplifier?, ambient?, show_particles?, show_icon?}, applied at INFINITE_DURATION while active. A single effect may instead be authored as the root-level shorthand (effect/amplifier/... at the power root); root-level ambient/show_particles/show_icon/amplifier also cascade as defaults onto every entry that omits them. Empty list = no effect.

condition.description: Optional EntityCondition gating the effects: they apply only while it passes and are cleared the moment it stops (default always-true).

toggleable.description: When true the power binds a keybind that flips the effects on/off; off clears them (default true).

default_off.description: Toggleable powers only: when true the effects START disabled so the player must opt in via the keybind (default false).

invisibility.description: If true the player gains Invisibility while in phantom form (default true).

no_gravity.description: If true gravity is disabled so the player can free-fly (default true).

action.description: Required. The action this power blocks: fall_damage, fire, drown, freeze, sprint_food, armor_equip (per-slot via head/chest/legs/feet), chestplate_equip (legacy alias = armor_equip chest), eye_damage, water_damage, swim, sleep, elytra, or none. Unknown values fall back to none.

active_when.description: Player-state gate the prevention applies under: always, not_sneaking, sneaking, not_on_ground, or on_ground (default always). E.g. not_sneaking lets a crouching Avian still take fall damage. Unknown values fall back to always.

head.description: ARMOR_EQUIP only: when true, block equipping items in the helmet slot. Ignored for other actions (default false).

chest.description: ARMOR_EQUIP only: when true, block equipping items in the chestplate slot. Ignored for other actions (default false).

legs.description: ARMOR_EQUIP only: when true, block equipping items in the leggings slot. Ignored for other actions (default false).

feet.description: ARMOR_EQUIP only: when true, block equipping items in the boots slot. Ignored for other actions (default false).

damage_types.description: Comma-separated damage-type filter (msgIds, registry keys, or #tags); only matching killing blows are prevented. Omit to prevent every lethal hit.

invert.description: When true treat damage_types as a blacklist: prevent all deaths EXCEPT the listed types. Meaningless (ignored) without damage_types. Default false.

set_health.description: Health the player is left at after a save; clamped to at least 1 so they don't re-die next tick (default 1.0).

cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks the power goes inert after a save (20 = 1s); default 0 = no cooldown (Origins behaviour, every lethal hit saved).

entity_action.description: Optional EntityAction run on the player each time a lethal hit is prevented (defaults to noop).

condition.description: Optional EntityCondition gating the save: the power only prevents death while it passes (default always-true).

projectile_types.description: Projectiles blocked: arrow, fireball, trident, all, or an entity id (default arrow).

chance.description: Probability 0.0-1.0 an incoming matching projectile is negated (default 1.0).

teleport.description: If true a successful dodge triggers a short random teleport (default false).

teleport_range.description: Max teleport distance in blocks on a dodge when enabled (default 16).

bonus_mining_speed.description: Fraction of base mining speed added to crafted tools (default 0.25).

bonus_attack_damage.description: Fraction of base attack damage added to crafted weapons (default 0.20).

bonus_armor_toughness.description: Flat armor toughness added to crafted/smithed armor (default 1.0).

durability_multiplier.description: Fraction of base durability added to crafted items (default 0.10).

master_slots.description: Random master-tier villager trades added to wandering traders (default 3).

treasure_chance.description: Probability 0.0-1.0 a rare treasure trade is also offered (default 0.25).

min.description: Lower bound of the resource bar.

max.description: Upper bound of the resource bar.

start_value.description: Initial value on grant; defaults to max.

regen_rate.description: Amount added each regen interval (0 = no regen).

regen_condition.description: Optional EntityCondition gating regen; defaults always-true.

min_action.description: Optional EntityAction fired when the value reaches min.

max_action.description: Optional EntityAction fired when the value reaches max.

hud_render.description: Nested HUD-render block; its keys map to flat label/color/hidden components.

label.description: Bar label shown on the HUD.

should_render.description: When false, hides the bar (stored inverted as hidden=true).

restrictions.description: List of slot restrictions, each {slot, item?, tag?}: when a matching item (by id and/or #tag) is equipped in that EquipmentSlot (head/chest/legs/feet/mainhand/offhand) it is ejected back to the inventory. An entry with neither item nor tag bars the whole slot. Empty list (default) restricts nothing.

entity_types.description: Entity ids or #tags that flee the player within 8 blocks.

shader.description: Resource location of the post shader to apply (e.g. minecraft:spider).

max_orbs.description: Max simultaneous orbs; placing past this removes the oldest (default 4).

radius.description: Block radius around each orb given Darkness+Blindness (default 28).

cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks before the orb ability can be reused (20 = 1s; default 100).

tick_interval.description: Ticks between each darkness pulse from orbs (20 = 1s; default 20).

modify_reach.description: If true, reach scales with body size too (default true). For independent reach use attribute_modifier.

moisture_threshold.description: Min slime moisture (0-1) to split instead of dying (default 0.75).

teleport_distance.description: Blocks teleported in a random direction on split (default 50).

teleport_y_range.description: Max +/- Y offset applied to the split teleport (default 10).

split_max_h_p.description: Max HP set right after splitting, in half-hearts (default 4.0).

recovery_ticks.description: Ticks for reduced max HP to ease back to normal (20 = 1s; default 2400).

levels_per_h_p.description: Experience levels needed per +1 max HP half-heart (default 10).

max_bonus_h_p.description: Cap on total bonus max HP granted, in half-hearts (default 20).

drain_per_tick.description: Moisture lost per tick when not in water/rain (default 0.0004).

fire_drain_multiplier.description: Drain multiplier while the player is on fire (default 10.0).

water_refill_per_tick.description: Moisture regained per tick while in water or rain (default 0.005).

regen_threshold.description: Moisture (0-1) above which the player gets Regeneration (default 0.75).

armor_penalty_threshold.description: Moisture (0-1) below which the player loses 4 armor (default 0.10).

dot_damage.description: Magic damage dealt per interval when moisture is too low (default 1.0).

dot_interval.description: Ticks between drying-out damage ticks (20 = 1s; default 40).

detection_multiplier.description: Mob detection range multiplier; lower = sneakier (default 0.3).

oneOf.$comment: neoorigins:starting_equipment — grants one or more items the first time the power is applied after origin commit. Accepts BOTH a legacy singular shape (top-level item/count/enchantments/legacy_tag/components) and a plural shape (stacks: [ { item, count, enchantments, legacy_tag, components } ]). When `stacks` is non-empty it takes precedence over the singular root fields; otherwise the root `item` is wrapped as a one-entry list. `grant_id` dedups the whole bundle (not individual stacks) so retries via /origin reset re-grant everything.

grant_id.description: Unique id tracked so the bundle is granted only once per player.

item.description: Legacy singular shape: item id granted once. Optional when `stacks` is provided.

count.description: Stack size for the singular shape (default 1).

enchantments.description: Singular-shape enchantments applied to the granted item.

legacy_tag.description: Singular-shape Apoli-style flat SNBT translated into data components at grant time.

components.description: Singular-shape SNBT data-component patch applied to the granted item.

stacks.description: Plural shape (v2.1.6). Each entry mirrors the singular root field names. When non-empty, takes precedence over the singular item/count/enchantments/legacy_tag/components fields.

activation_ticks.description: Ticks of continuous sneaking before invisibility kicks in (200 = 10s).

mob_type.description: Entity type id to summon, e.g. minecraft:zombie.

max_count.description: Max minions of this type alive at once before summoning is blocked.

cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks before the summon ability can be reused (200 = 10s).

hunger_cost.description: Hunger consumed each time a minion is summoned.

despawn_ticks.description: Ticks a minion lasts before despawning (18000 = 15 min).

death_damage.description: Damage dealt to the player when a minion dies (half-hearts).

head.description: Item id for the summoned mob's helmet slot (defaults to iron helmet).

chest.description: Item id for the summoned mob's chest slot (optional).

legs.description: Item id for the summoned mob's leggings slot (optional).

feet.description: Item id for the summoned mob's boots slot (optional).

mainhand.description: Item id placed in the summoned mob's main hand (optional).

offhand.description: Item id placed in the summoned mob's off hand (optional).

range.description: Max distance in blocks to raycast for the mob to tame (default 16).

max_tamed.description: Max tamed mobs alive at once before taming is blocked.

cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks before the tame ability can be reused (200 = 10s).

hunger_cost.description: Hunger consumed each time a mob is tamed.

despawn_ticks.description: Ticks a tamed mob lasts before despawning (36000 = 30 min).

death_damage.description: Damage dealt to the player when a tamed mob dies (half-hearts).

hostile_only.description: When true (default), only mobs implementing Enemy (zombies, skeletons, creepers, ...) can be tamed. Set false to allow taming any non-player Mob (animals, golems, villagers).

health_bonus.description: Flat max-health added to your tamed animals (half-hearts; default 4).

speed_bonus.description: Flat movement-speed added to your tamed animals (default 0.1).

radius.description: Block radius around the player scanned for tamed animals (default 32).
Block radius for sharing positive potion effects with tamed animals.

damage.description: Damage reflected to a melee attacker when you are hit (half-hearts; default 2).

fire_ticks.description: Ticks the attacker is set on fire on reflect (0 = none; 20 = 1s).

interval.description: Ticks between each action run (20 = 1s; default 20).

action_type.description: Periodic action dispatched by OriginEventHandler: teleport_on_damage or none (default none).

damage.description: Damage dealt to each entity in the cone (half-hearts; default 4).

knockback_strength.description: Forward push applied to hit entities (default 2).

range.description: Max reach of the water cone in blocks (default 8).

cone_angle.description: Total width in degrees of the forward damage cone (default 60).

cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks before the wave can be reused (100 = 5s).

default.description: Initial boolean value before the toggle is first flipped (default false). 'true' declares 'on until flipped off' without a GAINED hook.

radius.description: Block radius around the player whose villager trades refresh (default 8).

max_blocks.description: Maximum connected log blocks broken in one chop (default 64).

chance.description: Probability 0.0-1.0 of an extra baby when animals breed (default 1.0).

fluid.description: Which fluid surface you can walk on: water, lava, or both (default both).

blocked_blocks.description: Block ids that cannot be phased through (default obsidian/bedrock).

exhaustion_per_tick.description: Food exhaustion added each tick while phasing in solids (default 0.15).

always_on.description: If true phasing is always-active instead of a toggle key (default false).

oneOf.$comment: Fallback branch — any registered type not exhaustively schema'd yet. Allows extra fields permissively.
